caption: The page Pricing Plans inside the app in the Shopify admin: Basic $0 / month with 300 Impressions (Up to 300 impressions, Unlimited subscribers and segmentation, Abandoned cart recovery campaigns, Send and schedule campaigns, AI generated contents for campaigns, Intelligent delivery, basic e-mail help) and Pro $4.99 / month with 3K Impressions (All features in free plan, Up to 3000 impressions, Unlimited campaigns and automations, premium help), each with a Subscribe button that was not used for payment; the store name in the bottom left corner of the menu is hidden.

The Shopify screen Approve subscription for the plan Pro of Meeri: Push Notifications: $4,99 USD every 30 days, an app spending limit of a maximum of $99,00 USD per 30 days, the row Add payment method, Your next bill with the text You have a 7-day free trial ending on 24 Nov. and a Subtotal and Total of $4,99 (plus any applicable taxes, with usage charges on top that appear on the invoices) and a greyed out Approve button; the text You will not be billed for this test charge is not on the screen, and nothing was approved; the store name in the bottom left corner of the menu is hidden.

The Shopify screen Approve subscription for the plan Free (Basic) of Meeri: Push Notifications: This app bills you for usage charges, You will be billed for this app when you begin to use it, an app spending limit of a maximum of $99,00 USD per 30 days, the row Add payment method and a greyed out Approve button; no test charge sentence is on the screen, and nothing was approved; the store name in the bottom left corner of the menu is hidden.

The Automations page of the app: the Welcome rows (a Push message switched on and a Welcome Email switched off), Browse Abandonment (Push, off) and the section Abandoned Cart with the stages No. 1 (30 minutes after Cart Abandoned), No. 2 (6 hours after Cart Abandoned) and No. 3 (12 hours after Cart Abandoned), all on the channel Push and switched on, with 0 impressions, 0 clicks and 0.00 revenue; the store name in the bottom left corner of the menu and in the welcome texts is hidden.
